detail.longDescription: As a software engineer who's built hundreds of integrations over the years, I demand a lot from integration platforms. In the case of Tray, the promise is that you can orchestrate workflows and enterprise-grade AI agents. That's a claim many other platforms make, but Tray has been in the automation business for more than a decade, so there's some level of credibility there.
